description: §19.16.4 — `defer` is legal in a pure `fn` (it is control flow, not an effect). The deferred body here writes only a LOCAL, which §48 permits. The return value `return acc + 1` is computed before the deferred `acc = 0` runs: settle(20) = 41. No E-FN-* and no E-DEFER-* fires.
rationale: §19.16.4: `defer` is legal in a `fn`; the deferred body is subject to every §48.3 prohibition (a local write is not prohibited). §19.16.2: the return value (here `return acc + 1`; S469: no implicit tail return) is evaluated before the deferred bodies run, so the returned value is 41, not 1.
